data.narrative:
Trilobio is a Seed-stage biotech company founded by Roya Amini-Naieni and Maximilian Schommer that has raised $11M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 3 public peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private companies in the Biotech & Health sector, including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable approach, applying a 2.5x multiplier to the $11M raised as a valuation proxy. This yields an implied valuation of $28M. The Peer-Median method could not be applied due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow peer set. Public-Comp Anchoring using the sector P/S median of 6.6x across the three public tickers is not feasible, as Trilobio's revenue is not disclosed—a typical constraint for private-stage companies.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $23M to $32M, with a median point of $28M. The single-method conclusion reflects the limited data available at Seed stage. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct same-stage private comparables and undisclosed revenue, which would strengthen P/S and revenue-multiple approaches. This range should be refined as the company approaches Series A and additional market data becomes available.
